fields.v: Tasks: 86 CTXbench tasks with an ACF at the task commit (larger of AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md kept, saved under the filename read by the harness). Configurations: 4 styles x 4 harness-model combinations. Baseline: none without the policy; styles compared within task. Held constant: policy position (last line), surrounding ACF text, task, harness version within pair. Acceptance: mechanical compliance check. Repetitions: 3. Human intervention: none stated. Statistics: Friedman (tasks as blocks), Wilcoxon signed-rank with Pratt ties and Holm, matched-pairs rank-biserial

Style matters in 3 of 4 combinations (Friedman chi2(3) = 17.68, 102.02, 59.62, p < 0.001; Qwen3-Coder-Next 3.33, p = 0.343). Conditional lower than Prescriptive and Explanatory in all three significant combinations (rank-biserial 0.29 to 0.97). Best style varies: Prescriptive on claude-sonnet-5 (P-E +0.70*), Explanatory on gpt-oss-120b (P-E -0.82*); no P-E difference on claude-opus-5. Prohibitive significantly lower than P and E on sonnet-5 and gpt-oss-120b. Spread 14 points (opus-5) to 54 points (sonnet-5)

Yes for three combinations (distinguished styles with significance); not for Qwen3-Coder-Next (floor effect). Repeatable: 3 runs, replication package. Limitations: one text per style (wording/length confound); one marker-type policy; exclusion of sessions without Python changes; tasks clustered in 10 repositories so p-values may be optimistic; harness and model confounded across the two pairs

Style confounded with a single realisation; policy type specific; exclusions raise levels; non-independent tasks; cannot separate harness from model for the open-weight pair. Future: wider variety of policies, automatic selection of writing style per model and harness. Advice: avoid conditional phrasing; style tuned for one agent may not transfer
